“Provisions and reserves” first builds up 24 rounds of rations, then returns to basic farming; when wood reaches 120, it replenishes scrap to 60 and tools to 24. “Construction and salvage” prioritizes replenishing scrap and tools to 120, and puts the expanded toolmaking station to work; once tools are sufficient, four workers return to reserve. Actual output is still limited by available workers, health, and raw materials.

Standardized medical equipment is enough to staff a full medical shift. Establish basic care first, then welcome new families to town.
The public clinic is now open. It adds four medical roles; producing medicine still consumes food, scrap, and labor.
The public school provides desks for school-age children and a place for teachers to study the knowledge of the old world.
The school adds four teacher roles. Each teacher on duty can teach twenty children.
A properly maintained pumping station can carry fresh water to more distant fields.
The new plots add eight farming roles. Fields must be worked to yield crops, and a loss of water from the pumping station will also reduce yields.
Standard gauges and jigs let more toolmakers work together.
The toolmaking shop adds four workstations. It still needs a steady supply of wood and scrap.
The clinic and school are both staffed. Work can now begin on homes for more families.
The residential district is complete, adding twenty-four beds. Empty houses will not bring in residents on their own.
Town works connect the roads, drains, and homes. Rations and medicine must still be stocked before the next group of displaced people arrives.
Neighborhood housing is complete, adding ninety-six beds. Convoy admissions will still depart in groups according to rosters, travel costs, and public service capacity.
Standards and measures
Tools, beams, and cargo crates finally use the same measures. Public facilities can now be expanded in stages.
Town works
Roads, drainage, housing, and work areas are now on one master plan. Neighborhood housing can now be built, and materials allocated to expand the third and fourth industrial facilities.
